projects.name: NJDOT Statewide Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Locations (Tran_STIP_24_33)
projects.notes: NJDOT GIS official layer of mappable FY2024-2033 STIP projects (planned/programmed). TOTAL and FY_2022..FY_2033 are programmed dollars in MILLIONS per fiscal year; the first FY column with money indicates timing. UPC is the NJDOT project number; CIS_SUBCATEGORY gives finer work type; MUNC1-4 municipalities; MPO field. CMSSTATUS and AWARD_DATE are mostly blank, so there is no reliable phase field: treat all rows as programmed/planned.

projects.name: NJDOT Current Capital Projects (hosted by Rutgers account, not NJDOT)
projects.notes: Small third-party-hosted (Rutgers user) copy of NJDOT capital projects in the delivery pipeline with design phase codes (Phase, e.g. CD=concept development) and In_the_STIP flag. No cost or dates; currency unknown, use as secondary only.

summary: NJDOT publishes a STIP FY2024-2033 polyline layer (264 mapped projects, costs in $M by fiscal year) that works for planned projects. Parcel research pending.
